entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Plane that became the Eldrazi's prison and a wild, savage place.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Nightmarish titanic creatures of the Blind Eternities that feed on the energy of worlds.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: Space between planes where the Eldrazi are native.

entities.name: Kozilek, Butcher of Truth
entities.description: Legendary Eldrazi whose name gave rise to the merfolk deity Cosi.

entities.name: Ulamog, the Infinite Gyre
entities.description: Legendary Eldrazi whose name gave rise to the merfolk deity Ula.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Dragon planeswalker who helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Vampire planeswalker who helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Stone-shaping lithomancer
entities.description: Planeswalker, little known, who helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: Subterranean chamber concealing the lock-spell that holds the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Ula
entities.description: Merfolk god of the sea's depths, derived from memories of Ulamog.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: Merfolk goddess of sky and wind; also the name of the ruined floating castle in Tazeem.

entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: Merfolk trickster god of land and earth, derived from memories of Kozilek.

entities.name: Kamsa
entities.description: Kor goddess of the wind, 'the breath of the world'.

entities.name: Mangeni
entities.description: Kor god of the sea, 'blood of the world'.

entities.name: Talib
entities.description: Kor god of the earth, 'body of the world'.

entities.name: Merfolk of Zendikar
entities.description: Zendikar race worshipping Ula, Emeria and Cosi.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: Zendikar race worshipping Kamsa, Mangeni and Talib.

entities.name: Lighthouse at Sea Gate
entities.description: Research facility run by Ula-creed merfolk.

entities.name: Jenna Helland
entities.description: Creative team writer who wrote the merfolk deities.

events.summary: Thousands of years ago three Eldrazi descend on Zendikar and spawn brood lineages to pillage it.
events.quote: Thousands of years ago, three Eldrazi monstrosities descended on Zendikar

events.summary: Ugin, a lithomancer and Sorin Markov trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar with a lock-spell at the Eye of Ugin and leave.
events.quote: the planeswalkers trapped the Eldrazi on Zendikar

events.summary: Zendikar survives and slowly recovers as the brood lineages die off and the colossi fall inert.
events.quote: The brood lineages died off and the Eldrazi colossi fell inert

events.summary: It is revealed that merfolk deities Cosi and Ula derive from dim memories of Kozilek and Ulamog, so the Eldrazi came before religion.
events.quote: the merfolk deities Cosi and Ula are derived from dim memories of Kozilek and Ulamog

relations.note: merfolk follow the creed of one of three deities
relations.quote: usually adopting the creed of one of the three as their own

relations.note: kor worship a pantheon of three
relations.quote: The kor worship a small, simple pantheon of deities

relations.note: Cosi derived from memories of Kozilek
relations.quote: the merfolk deities Cosi and Ula are derived from dim memories of Kozilek and Ulamog

relations.note: Ula derived from memories of Ulamog
relations.quote: the merfolk deities Cosi and Ula are derived from dim memories of Kozilek and Ulamog
